name: EUPHORBIA LATHYRIS
key_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting of copious clear water, intermingled with white, gelatinous lumps.

Labored breathing. Breath cold, musty odor. Cough; first, a hacking, as from inhalation of sulphur; later on, paroxysmal, like whooping-cough, in regular paroxysms, ending in diarrhśa and vomiting, with sleepiness between each paroxysm.
Weak and fluttering heart-action. Pulse 120, full, bounding, somewhat irregular.

head_symptoms: Almost closed from śdema of lids.
respiratory_symptoms: Labored breathing. Breath cold, musty odor. Cough; first, a hacking, as from inhalation of sulphur; later on, paroxysmal, like whooping-cough, in regular paroxysms, ending in diarrhśa and vomiting, with sleepiness between each paroxysm.
gi_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting of copious clear water, intermingled with white, gelatinous lumps.
urinary_symptoms: Inflammation of scrotum resulting in deep acrid ulcers, with intense itching and burning; worse, touching the parts from washing.
skin_symptoms: Erythema, beginning on uncovered parts, on face, and spreading over whole body; glossy, rough, śdematous, with burning and smarting. Fine bran-like desquamation following in the wake of the erythema. Eruption rough, scaly, smarting, and burning; when scratched forms deep, ragged ulcers; skin where ulcerated remains red.
sleep_symptoms: Restlessness at night. Sleep disturbed, anxious dreams.
fever_symptoms: Temperature increased. Body bathed in profuse perspiration, standing out like beads on forehead; later, cold, clammy perspiration on forehead.
